intermediate.title: KOM Sprint (3) Cocca di Lodrino (88.1 km)

story: After a fiercely contested opening hour filled with attacks, a 28-rider breakaway formed after the first climb. Rémi Cavagna’s solo move was caught with 60 km remaining before repeated attacks reduced the race to a leading group of six in the finale. Michael Valgren then launched a late move in the final kilometre to win ahead of Andreas Leknessund and Damiano Caruso.
